parameters.name: RoleID
parameters.description: Unique Identifier of the role. Depending on the implementation this can be the unique identifier assigned by the underlying system.

parameters.name: RoleName
parameters.description: Name of the current Role. MUST NOT be {{empty}} for an enabled entry.

parameters.name: StaticRole
parameters.description: A static role is a fixed role that is always available in the system. When set to {{true}}, the role cannot be removed.

parameters.name: RequiredCapabilities
parameters.description: Capabilities that have been assigned to this {{object}}.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to the role characteristics. If this object is referenced by a {{param|.SoftwareModules.ExecutionUnit.{i}.RequiredUserRoles}}, then the device MAY reject deletion requests, as it could cause instability in the environment.
